name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
description: A goblin who speaks of grabbing time after people flee and before the enemy arrives.

description_citations.work: Neon Dynasty Commander: card flavor text

timeline.summary: Krenko describes the moment between people fleeing and the enemy arriving.
timeline.quote: After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time.
